description: This file is a PHP source file for the ADODB XML Schema handling system used in the VTigerCRM project. It defines classes and functions to parse, transform, and generate SQL schema and data manipulation commands from XML schemas, facilitating database creation and migration.

classes.name: dbObject
classes.description: Abstract class providing basic methods for database schema objects, such as tables and indexes.

classes.name: dbTable
classes.description: Represents a database table, enabling the definition of fields, indexes, and SQL generation for creation, upgrades, and deletion.

classes.name: dbIndex
classes.description: Represents a database index, allowing the creation and deletion of indexes via SQL.

classes.name: dbData
classes.description: Handles data rows for insertion and update operations during schema processing.

classes.name: dbQuerySet
classes.description: Represents a set of SQL queries for batch execution, supporting query building and prefixing.

classes.name: adoSchema
classes.description: Main class to parse, transform, and apply XML schemas to the database, generate SQL, and handle schema conversion.

methods.name: adoSchema
methods.description: Constructor for the adoSchema class, initializes environment and configuration.

methods.name: ParseSchema
methods.description: Loads and converts an XML schema file into SQL queries for database creation.

methods.name: ParseSchemaString
methods.description: Parses an XML schema string into SQL queries.

methods.name: ExecuteSchema
methods.description: Applies the generated SQL schema to the database.

methods.name: SetUpgradeMethod
methods.description: Sets how existing database objects should be upgraded (e.g., ALTER, REPLACE).

methods.name: ExistingData
methods.description: Configures how to handle duplicate data rows during schema application (insert, update, ignore).

methods.name: ConvertSchemaString
methods.description: Transforms an XML schema string from one version to another.

methods.name: ConvertSchemaFile
methods.description: Transforms an XML schema file from one version to another.
